notes.title: Frog Space Version 1.0.0
notes.notes:
Hello, this is HIGHLENDID.


I haven't updated Frog Space for a long time since the last update, but I've updated it for the final launch now. The changes are as follows, and I wanted to make Frog Space easier and more fun for players to play the Frog Space through this update.


[b]- Optimize timing by changing the way terrain moves
- Add a number of Non-Player Character (NPCs) to help you play.
- Story line configuration
- Rebuild the Bullfrog Stage
- Create game ending.


- System changes that detect jumping and landing conditions (stabilizing the wider area)
- Change the way you use spacing technology to make it more effective.


- Changing the way game controllers (game pads) are operated


- Apply other errors and corrections[/b]


I will wrap up the story of Frog Space with this update and plan to officially release it in January, 2021.

(However, we will correct any further errors.)



Please enjoy the play and leave your requests in the comments and we will reflect them as much as possible.

I'll be back with a new game.

Thank you SSSSSSO MUCH.


[b]HIGHLENDID[/b]

notes.title: Update EA 2.0.1
notes.notes:
[i][b]"Patch note EA 2.0.1"[/b][/i]



[i][b]"I updated to show this."[/b][/i]


There are three new stages in Chapter 3.

- Red-roofed house
- Garden
- Pond of Bullfrog

A new form of movement is possible on the new stage. However, first you need to acquire a frog 'Space'. When you acquire 'space', you can 'spacing' through 'spacer'.

Pass the Bullfrog's test using spacing!



[i][b]" Was the beginning a little difficult?"[/b][/i]


I made the initial stage a little easier so that you can enjoy the game comfortably. Also, I changed the image so that small mice don't misunderstand as bugs.

Many players expect that the difficulties in the early part of the game will be reduced.



[i][b]"Other modifications"[/b][/i]


[b]Return storage point[/b]

- Movement speed 100 -> 150 when returning to storage point as far

- Modify storage point return screen

[b]View Mode[/b]

- Adjust visibility (mouse right click) angle 0 -> 5

[b]Jump and fall[/b]

- Minimum jump height increase 1.14 -> 4.0 when jumping

- Optimized landing determination

- Increases gravitational acceleration while falling 10 -> 15

[b]Map[/b]

- Slightly refined the shape of the entire map.

[b]Controller[/b]

- The right joystick of the controller has been changed to adjust the view.

- The sensitivity of the controller has been adjusted.

[b]User interface[/b]

- 'Settings' screen has been refined.

notes.notes:

notes.title: Next update information
notes.notes:
Hello, Players.


Unfortunately, there were no updates this week, but I'd like to inform you that I've finished the basics of Chapter 3 and am currently working on effects, sound additions, and stage testing.

(Update within May if test and modification can be completed within the next week, but if problem issues are found, then will be updated in June)



[i][b]"Stage"[/b][/i]


'Chapter 3', which will be updated as early as next week, will include three additional stages:

[b]- Red-roofed house (internal)
- Garden
- Pond of bullfrog [/b]


[i][b] Red roof house[/b][/i]

The difficulty of the stage is not that difficult. Instead, I'm going to use that stage to tell you the rough story of 'Frog space' and to build up the fundamentals of new technology 'Spacing'.
(Also, there's a chance to get on a cute robot. If I get a good idea, I'm thinking of upgrading to a mini-game.)


[i][b]Garden[/b][/i]

I wanted to create two clearable routes, but I thought one of them was easier than expected, so I would like to add another one first and make a better one later.


[i][b]Pond of bullfrog[/b][/i]

There were no obstructions other than 'rising water' on the 'Waterfall Stage', right?



[i][b]"Amendments"[/b][/i]


I've added hidden paths that have never been before, and added some risks to the shortened course.

I've trimmed the road a little to make it easier to play.

I've added a panel to view the records on the main scene if I have the "Frog King" in hand, but I'm considering whether to release it in the upcoming update or together as I add the final chapter.
(This is related to the record competition system with other players.)

Only the description of the currently selected operating tool (mouse or controller) is displayed in the 'Loading scene' and 'Settings'.

A new frog 'Space' is added.



[i][b]"Spacing"[/b][/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37304679/460Aee5a75880de557fc3a4329a80da7e0056311.gif[/img]


'Spacers' are active only when you are playing with 'Space'.

When you touch the 'spacer', you jump again.




[i][b]"Planning after update due"[/b][/i]


Chapter 4: Sky Bridge

Record Competition System

Costumes

Hidden Stages

Overall Stage Environment Element

Early Access Player's Objects
(If you tell me about your symbol, I'll try to install as much as I can without damaging the image of the game. Please use e-mail, YouTube, discussion, evaluation, etc. <EX. HIGHLENDID : Put the frog in.> Details will be given in the event notice after all chapter updates are completed.)



Cheers,

HIGHLENDID

notes.title: Small update EA 1.2.1
notes.notes:
[i][b]Patchnote EA 1.2.1[/b][/i][/i]



[i][b]"Controller"[/b][/i]


Pressing the up arrow on the controller, immediately rotates the frog in current direction of camera.
The rotation speed of the frog has been adjusted a little faster.



[i][b]"Back to Storage Point"[/b][/i]


I've trimmed the return animation of the store point a little bit more.

notes.title: Update EA 1.2.0
notes.notes:
[i][b]Patchnote EA 1.2.0[/b][/i][/i]



[i][b]"Play game with game pad!"[/b][/i]


The Frog Space now supports game pads. Made based on XBOX ONE. Stay comfortable and play with the game pad!



[i][b]"Ready forward for water!"[/b][/i]


Previously, when the frog, Froxy, was standing on the road, it was leaning a little forward. This update has prevented that from happening and will allow you to jump forward normally if you are standing on the floor.



[i][b]"Fairy?!"[/b][/i]


I have modified the previously updated motion sickness prevention image. Also, when returning to the storage point, the overall camera angle will be changed, so dizziness will be less than before.



[i][b]"Other"[/b][/i]


I think many people find skateboarding more difficult than I thought, so I made it a "little" easier to control.
At the beginning of the game, I expanded my skateboarding a little.
In the stage where the floor rotates, the floor rotates a little less, and the column is a little wider.

notes.title: Small update EA 1.1.7
notes.notes:
[i][b]Patchnote EA 1.1.7[/b][/i]



[i][b]"Modifications"[/b][/i]


I corrected the error of falling down through the diving board.
- The entire game has been added with codes that used to improve landing stability on the diving board, and the overlay has been deleted.

I modified the frog proxy a little more neatly.

The range of judgment of lotus, the storage point, has been expanded a little bit.

notes.title: Small update EA 1.1.6
notes.notes:
[i][b]Patchnote EA 1.1.6[/b][/i][/i]



[i][b]"I've arrived at the lotus."[/b][/i]


I increased the storage range of lotus flowers by 125%. Now you won't have to touch the lotus to save game.



[i][b]"I've already seen it."[/b][/i]


You can now skip the 'Chapter View' that you can see in the section where the new chapter begins.



[i][b]"Others"[/b][/i]


The next stage is coming soon. If you haven't won the 'Frog King' at the arrival point, hurry up!

The screenshot of the store page is up to date.

notes.title: Small update EA 1.1.5
notes.notes:
[i][b]Patchnote EA 1.1.5[/b][/i][/i]



[i][b]"I'm dizzy"[/b][/i]


When returning to the storage point, there are users who complain of motion sickness symptoms due to fast switching of the screen, so I added elements that can darken the screen and concentrate their vision.

This update may have eased the symptoms of motion sickness, and I'll try to make a better update on this area.

notes.title: Small update EA 1.1.4
notes.notes:
[b][i]Patchnote EA 1.1.4[/i][/b][/b]



[i][b]"There was such a thing?"[/b][/i]


The Frog Space is designed to use minimal keys, but I added a 'keys description' image because I thought we needed a way to check for keys at any time.
This can be found on the main screen, the loading screen, and the 'ESC' setting in the game.



[i][b]"Others"[/b][/i]

I removed the function of getting off the skateboard through the space bar because I thought I no longer needed it.
I modified some textures in the game.

notes.title: Small update EA 1.1.3
notes.notes:
[i][b]Patchnote EA 1.1.3[/b][/i][/i]



[i][b]" too long."[/b][/i]


There was an opinion that the camera was moving a little slowly around the chapter, so I increased the speed a little bit.



[i][b]"I'm dizzy."[/b][/i]


There was an opinion that the way the guidebook rotates at the beginning of the game causes dizziness, so I corrected it to no longer rotate.

notes.title: Small update EA 1.1.2
notes.notes:
[b][i]Patchnote EA 1.1.2[/i][/b][/b]



[i][b]"I need a guidebook!"[/b][/i]


I've moved the location of the second guidebook with "Breaking" on it a little bit forward. Now, you will be able to solve the problem of not knowing how to jump from the beginning.



[i][b]"What?"[/b][/i]


Spanish, Chinese, German, Italian, and Russian were added. If there is a typo, please let me know and I will correct it ASAP.

notes.title: Small Update EA 1.1.1
notes.notes:
[i]Patch Note EA 1.1.1[/i]



[b][i]"Leaves, rejuvenate."[/i][/b]


The 'yellow leaves' in chapter 2 have regained strength, leaving them hanging 25 percent longer than before.



[b][i]"My cat turned off the game."[/i][/b]


I found that the game was turned off when playing the guidebook video, so I corrected it as follows.

[b]- The resolution of the videos has been slightly lowered.
- If an error occurs when playing a video, the video is not played but only the video description below is made.[/b]

These errors can occur in Windows 7 environments, and I will take further action later.

You can check the guidebook video at the link below.
https://youtu.be/fBlHi5mPQ0k



[b][i]"Come back!"[/i][/b]


Corrected the error that leaves in hidden place in chapter 2 were not regenerated.

notes.title: Update EA 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[b][i]Patch Note EA 1.1.0[/i][/b][/b]



[i] "One day, beautiful colored water flowed into the pond where Froxy lived. Various creatures jumped into the water and enjoyed it, but then they began to get sick. Froxy heads out to the world looking for the cause of the incident."[/i]


Frog Space has its own story. The overall content is still private, but I added water, one of the main elements.



[i]"The more stages, the better."[/i]


There are three main technologies in the Frog Space: (Check out the guidebook in the game!)
[b](1) Breaking
(2) Holding
(3) Turning[/b]
The new stage is designed to help you to practice "Holding" and "Breaking" a little more. The form of the stage is different, but if you've figured out the principles of these technologies, you'll be able to clear it.



[i]"Other modifications"[/i]


Now at the beginning of the new chapter, I've added a "Chapter View" scene so you can see the overall terrain of that chapter. (You can preview it in the second trailer video on the store page.)

I changed the overall water element in the game.

"Blue Lotus" was added to the new stage, thereby changing the first chapter's "Last Lotus" to "Blue Lotus."

The color of the Thunderbolt is slightly adjusted.

I've slightly modified the terrain of the "skateboard stage."

notes.title: Update EA 1.0.4
notes.notes:
[i][b]PATCH NOTE EA 1.0.4[/b][/i]



[i]"I don't know what's what."[/i]


In the meantime, I thought that the users who played the game for the first time had a hard time learning the manipulation, and to solve this problem, I changed the stage at the beginning of the game to a more natural training place.

Since the first stage was longer, I added a skateboard tasting section so that it wouldn't get boring.

The contents of the guidebook have been modified to accommodate the new stage.



[i]Other modifications[/i]


I corrected the contents that were uncomfortable to see due to the reflection of sunlight in the guidebook. Now you can enjoy it from any direction.

The water in the waterfall stage corrected a bug that goes up too slowly.

notes.title: EA 1.0.3 Update | Bug fix, change difficulty level
notes.notes:
[b]EA 1.0.3 Update[/b]



[i]"The skateboard is too dangerous!"[/i]

The skateboard has been automatically lowered when the arrival point is reached.

I fixed the bug falling from the diving board.

The hangglider moves more accurately.


[i] "Unavoidable rocks make no sense."[/i]

The path of the moving rock (in the hangglider section) has been drastically modified to reduce the difficulty level and provide a more pleasant play.

We lowered the white water flow rate by about 10 percent on the waterfall stage.




[i]Other modifications[/i]

I fixed the frame to 144HZ.

I've turned up the sound of Froxy's footsteps.

notes.title: EA 1.0.2 Update | Add Language
notes.notes:
[b]EA 1.0.2 Update[/b]



[i]"Japanese and French have been added."[/i]


[i]"UI has been partially changed."[/i]

notes.title: EA 1.0.1 Update | Difficulty Level Down
notes.notes:
Reflecting player feedback, I lowered the difficulty level slightly in the beginning of the game.



[i] "Now the fastest mouse is retired at retirement, and has happy days."[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37304679/bc4193fa6696d0f4bbe2ad091d43c88531b36a.png]


The fastest rat and moving walls were removed by one unit each. The difficulties of the early part of the process may have been somewhat resolved.





[i]"The skateboard is not a rocket."[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37304679/fcbf36ea97eed4734ccb650f331ae300f1d8.png[/img]


Modified the phenomenon of skateboard bouncing into the sky. Now, when you climb up the wall, the skateboard slows down normally without bouncing into the sky.






[i]If there is any additional bug or modification, we will continue to update you. Thank you for your feedback. Have a good time. - HIGHLENDID[/i]
